title: The K worker stop check also runs the guard tests that read changed data files by path
body:
Why: D23 v2 run1 interim (51 units with K and PB graded, harness 27fe971): 6 of 14 K failures are only a regression in a repo-wide guard test the patch broke (552 fr40-report, 566 fr40-lanes, 573 receiver-evidence, 609 fr40-freeze, 617 capture-privacy-guard/host-path-guard, 621 tool-scope); both K-only losses (566, 621) are in this class. Every unit is validOnMerge, so these are real defects, not grader artifacts. The worker-stop related-test selection (#640, scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts relatedTests) follows imports only; these guards read data files by path (.claude/settings.json, spec/*.json) or scan the tree, so they are never selected. In 621 K ran npm test and still stopped on the red tool-scope test. Evidence: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/grades/<unit>.K.1.json, results/run1/621.K.rerun-replay.log.
Outcome: relatedTests also selects (1) every test whose source names a changed non-code file by its repository path literal, and (2) the tree-scanning guards under test/rules/; the Stop check refuses to end while any selected test is red.
Proof: unit tests in test/claude/worker-stop.test.ts: a change to .claude/settings.json selects test/tool-scope.test.ts; a change to spec/receivers.json selects test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs; a dev replay of units 566 and 621 with the new K is correct.
Scope: scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts, test/claude/worker-stop.test.ts.
